children: Matthew E. Gugino, Danaher’s EVP and Chief Financial Officer, sold 5,222 shares of common stock directly in two transactions on November 23, 2026, at a weighted average price of $226.65 per share, for a total of $1,183,564. After the transactions, he directly owned 9,371 shares and held 125 shares indirectly through his 401(k).

Christopher Bouda, Danaher’s VP and Chief Accounting Officer, sold 5,943 shares of common stock in two transactions on November 24, 2026, at a weighted average price of $229.33 per share, for a total of $1,362,936. After the sales, he directly owned 9,107 shares and indirectly owned 680 shares through his 401(k).
